title: InvalidToolArgumentsError unhandled by useChat, leading to infinite loop
body:
### Description

InvalidToolArgumentsError is unhandled by useChat, leading to an infinite loop of triggerRequest. This is extremely bad as credits can be fully drained easily this way.

The trace is as follows.

Tool arguments are returned and parsed by `parseToolCall` within `streamText`.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0565cd72934bc22bfc8f7a866abef97c643e6f86/packages/core/core/generate-text/run-tools-transformation.ts#L74-L77

When arguments are malformed, an `InvalidToolArgumentsError` is thrown.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0565cd72934bc22bfc8f7a866abef97c643e6f86/packages/core/core/generate-text/tool-call.ts#L74-L78

This error is then serialized and streamed back to the client.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0565cd72934bc22bfc8f7a866abef97c643e6f86/packages/core/core/generate-text/run-tools-transformation.ts#L119-L122

This error is received by `useChat` and is unhandled by `parseComplexResponse`.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0565cd72934bc22bfc8f7a866abef97c643e6f86/packages/ui-utils/src/parse-complex-response.ts#L34C23-L34C43

Because it is unhandled, `processChatStream` proceeds as normal and no new messages are emitted, leading to `triggerRequest` being called again.

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/0565cd72934bc22bfc8f7a866abef97c643e6f86/packages/react/src/use-chat.ts#L292-L349



### Code example

_No response_

### Additional context

I have a tool call defined as

```ts
showBarChart: {
	description:
		'Make a bar plot in matplotlib. The bars are positioned at x. Their dimensions are given by height. Always include the data parameter as a list of JSON objects.',
	parameters: z.object({
		data: z.array(z.record(z.number())).describe('JSON list for which to generate grouped bars'),
		axisKey: z.string().describe('The key to use for the x-axis.'),
		title: z.string().optional().describe('Set a title for the plot.'),
		yLabel: z.string().optional().describe('Set the label for the y-axis.'),
	}),
},
```

For some reason, gpt-4o doesn't return anything for data when it's defined as an array of records with variable keys. However, setting it to have defined keys does return valid data.

```ts
showBarChart: {
	description:
		'Make a bar plot in matplotlib. The bars are positioned at x. Their dimensions are given by height. Always include the data parameter as a list of JSON objects.',
	parameters: z.object({
		data: z
			.array(z.object({ x: z.number(), height: z.number() }))
			.describe('JSON list for which to generate grouped bars'),
		axisKey: z.string().describe('The key to use for the x-axis.'),
		title: z.string().optional().describe('Set a title for the plot.'),
		yLabel: z.string().optional().describe('Set the label for the y-axis.'),
	}),
},
```

linked_prs.title: fix (ai/react): prevent infinite tool call loop

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This is an agent issue because it involves tool invocation and tool argument parsing errors, leading to an infinite workflow loop in the agent system. The problem is tied to agent-specific components: tool definition, tool call handling, and orchestration logic (triggerRequest).
